campaign.name: The Hollow Reach

phases.name: Exploration Phase
phases.blurb: Gangs push out from what they hold and find out what is actually down here.

phases.name: Downtime
phases.blurb: No challenges. Recovery, trade and hiring before the next push.

phases.name: Occupation Phase
phases.blurb: Ground is claimed and held. Territory changes hands in earnest.

phases.name: Downtime
phases.blurb: No challenges. Recovery, trade and hiring before the last push.

phases.name: Takeover Phase
phases.blurb: The last fight over who runs the Reach.

phases.name: Campaign Wrap-up
phases.blurb: Final standings, the deep is tallied, and the Reach is called.

campaign.notice: Two ways into the deep section are known. Neither has been walked all the way in.

inner.label: Uncharted Deep
inner.blurb: Sealed until a Tech-Acquisitor party cut their way in and stopped transmitting. Only the border is mapped; what lies inside gets surveyed as gangs push into it.

gateways.name: The Theta Breach
gateways.notes: A Tech-Acquisitor party staged out of Reclaimers' Breach, cut through at the tip of the Coil Gardens and went in. Contact was lost on the second day. The coordinates were the last thing anyone sent up.

gateways.name: The Prospectors' Cut
gateways.notes: Found by Ironhead prospectors. Two companies have filed property rights over the shaft, neither claim struck out. Nobody has gone past the first chamber.

tunnels.name: The Theta Run
tunnels.notes: A maintenance bore running the width of the Reach, from the Sumptown wharves to Reclaimers’ Breach. It was cut to service the relay, and it runs on past the hole the Tech-Acquisitors made in its wall.

tunnels.name: The Deadfall
tunnels.notes: A collapsed transit shaft walked end to end only twice. It comes out at the shaft both Ironhead companies have filed on.

territories.name: Sumptown
territories.boon: Or recruit a ganger at a 25 credit discount
territories.notes: Barge wharves and a century of silt. Everything coming down from above lands here first.

territories.name: The Brood Vats
territories.standing: Goliath hold it, so it pays 25 a cycle instead of the 15 it would pay anyone else
territories.notes: Amneotic tanks in rows under the sump, lidded and bubbling. Sumptown grows its own, and the ones that come out wrong go back in.

territories.name: Rustfall Row
territories.boon: Or recruit a Slopper at a 30 credit discount, if you have none
territories.notes: Collapsed habs stacked nine deep with one kitchen still lit at the bottom. The queue forms before the shift horn and nobody skips it.

territories.name: Precinct House 22
territories.boon: Or recruit a ganger at a 25 credit discount
territories.notes: Built to hold two hundred. Currently holds nineteen, a vox relay and a great deal of institutional stubbornness.

territories.name: The Pit Market
territories.notes: A worked-out pit the Enforcers reopened and now run themselves. The market that gave it its name trades on the spoil heap at the top.

territories.name: The Coil Gardens
territories.boon: Or recruit a Dome Runner at a 30 credit discount, if you have none
territories.notes: Pipework grown into a thicket, and a dozen quiet doors inside it. Whatever leaves the sector by the back way goes through here first.

territories.name: Reclaimers' Breach
territories.boon: Or recruit a ganger at a 25 credit discount
territories.notes: Team 3 cut their way in here and named it for the work. The Tech-Acquisitor party staged out of this hold; their last transmission was a set of coordinates and nothing else.

territories.name: The Generatorium
territories.notes: Plasma conduits that have not gone cold in ten thousand years. Team 3 metered the output before they posted a single guard.

territories.name: The Cog Market
territories.notes: The up-hive draught comes down the old vent and keeps the stalls cool. Half the tech on the tables was still working when somebody pulled it out.

territories.name: Cinder Yard
territories.notes: Ash heaps that shift without warning. Three gangs are still down there somewhere.

territories.name: Grudgehold
territories.boon: Or recruit a ganger at a 25 credit discount
territories.notes: Cut into the rock and ledgered to the last slate. Bjorn filed the claim first and has the paperwork to prove it.

territories.name: Holestead
territories.boon: Or recruit a ganger at a 25 credit discount
territories.notes: Company housing, company store, company arbitration. Resource Extraction filed second and disputes that it matters.

territories.name: The Scrap Shoals
territories.notes: Quarterly extraction targets are posted at the gate. Somebody has been correcting them in blood.

territories.name: The Brass Stair
territories.boon: Or recruit an Ammo-Jack at a 30 credit discount, if you have none
territories.notes: The steps go down into the sump and keep going. Somebody has been stacking crates on the dry landings for a very long time.

territories.name: The Weeping Still
territories.notes: Groundwater bleeds through the rockcrete in sheets and the condensers underneath catch every drop. What comes out the other end is sold as medicine.

territories.name: Quarantine's End
territories.boon: Or recruit a ganger at a 25 credit discount
territories.notes: A cracked crystalflex dome, sealed off for something nobody will name and unsealed by the Chymists, who insist the air is clean now.

territories.name: The Still Rows
territories.boon: Escher only: instead of the income, add two lasguns to the stash for free
territories.effect: Faulty Machinery: at the start of each end phase, randomly select a fighter from each gang. If that fighter is active, they become suppressed.
territories.notes: Condensers in rows the length of a dome, half of them re-tooled to stamp power cells. Sola Dosis insists the fumes are therapeutic and the lasguns are legal.

territories.name: The Black Ledger
territories.notes: Debts here are recorded in a real book. People have died trying to edit it.

territories.name: The Sunken Nave
territories.boon: Or recruit a ganger at a 25 credit discount
territories.notes: Cawdor built it, something else kept it. Mycelium Section took the crypts and left the nave to the candles.

territories.name: Ratgut Tunnels
territories.notes: Not mapped, not mappable. Mycelium Section charges for guides and keeps a second ledger of who is worth money to somebody up-hive.

territories.name: The Bonepipe
territories.boon: Or recruit a Rogue Doc at a 30 credit discount, if you have none
territories.notes: The doc is good. The doc is also why several gangers answer to new names.

territories.name: The Harvest Yard
territories.notes: Spools of cable taller than a Goliath, and the vats behind them. The yard takes what the Underhive has finished with and sends it up-hive as protein.

territories.name: Relumen
territories.notes: A generatorium that had been dark long enough for the dust to settle in drifts. Archeo-Acquisitions Team 3 found the fault, cleared it, and the stack came back up on its own governors. It has been lit ever since, and nobody holds it.

territories.name: Hollowbore
territories.notes: A worked seam the Squats never filed, running back further than the lamps reach. Mycelium Section charted it and came back up with the air filters off the dead. Nobody holds it: it is simply on the map now, and anyone may call for it.

archeotech.name: The Voidshell Harness
archeotech.effect: Once per battle, take a 2+ save against a single attack. This save takes priority over the core rules for saves.

archeotech.name: The Time Sink
archeotech.effect: Any enemy fighter within Engagement range suffers −1 WS. Time runs slow around the bearer, and it is not pleasant to stand near.

archeotech.name: Conversion Eradicator
archeotech.effect: Every ranged weapon carried by this fighter gains +1 Strength and +1 AP, and becomes unstable.

archeotech.name: Hagioscope
archeotech.effect: Before the battle, nominate one enemy fighter to be scanned. Gain +1 to hit against that fighter until the end of the battle.

archeotech.name: Psychofamile Pheromones
archeotech.effect: Target an enemy fighter. For one round they are treated as a friendly model.

archeotech.name: The Obscuroptikon
archeotech.effect: Ranged attacks targeting the bearer suffer −1 to hit. The field shows a shooter a corridor that is not there, and a fighter who walked out of it an hour ago.

archeotech.name: Servo-chirurgic Claw
archeotech.effect: Blessed Augmetic Surgery (Double) — choose a friendly Seriously Injured fighter within 1". That fighter is no longer Seriously Injured and regains 1 lost Wound.

archeotech.name: The Uncreator Gauntlet
archeotech.effect: On a hit, one weapon or piece of wargear carried by the target is destroyed outright, chosen by the bearer. The gauntlet does not break things so much as decline to let them have been made.

archeotech.name: Archaeotoaster
archeotech.effect: A genuine bread-toasting machine out of the Dark Age of Technology. It does nothing of any value, and everybody wants one. Gain +1 reputation.

challenges.notes: The two prospecting outfits hold ground that touches at Holestead, and the tunnel they both filed on runs under it. Resource Extraction LLC were already down there, with a survey crew and a prior claim they are happy to read aloud.

The Chymist Cult filed on I-17 off the back of what came out of the Hollowbore: it sits one wall over from the workings Mycelium Section charted, and whatever is breathable down there is of professional interest. Nobody has been paired with them yet.
A second call from Precinct 22 this cycle, which is one more than the rules allow. Two concessions left half the Reach with nothing to do, so the arbitrator let it stand.

battles.summary: The Chymist Cult called Mycelium Section out over the Rogue Doc. Mycelium Section did not come, and the doc has new patrons.
Sumptown Industries called for the Corpse Farm and the Chymist Cult stood down rather than hold the gate. The vats are under Goliath management by the end of the shift.
Second concession of the cycle. Resource Extraction LLC counted the crates on the dry landings, found nobody arguing, and filed the claim.

rewards.gear: Two respirators out of the workings

battles.summary: First holding in the deep anyone has walked. Mycelium Section beat the Bjorn Prospectors to the seam and found it worked out but breathable: a mine, a side job paid on the way out, and no archeotech anywhere in it. The ground itself goes on the map unheld — the expedition charted it, it did not claim it.
The call the arbitrator let stand, and the Enforcers made it pay. Precinct 22 cleared the stacks off Sumptown Industries and the kitchen at the bottom now serves whoever the Palanites say it serves.

rewards.notes: The fifteen came with the discovery, along with the point of reputation for lighting the stack.

battles.summary: Archeo-Acquisitions Team 3 beat Mycelium Section off the approach and then did what Van Saar do: read the fault, cleared it, and brought the stack back up. One rep for the fight and one for the light, twenty credits for the win, twenty for the side job and fifteen for lighting the place at all. The claw came out of a maintenance cradle nobody had opened.
